BiblicalUsage: Makbir is plenty, abundance, and it appears once, in Job 36:31, where Elihu says God judgeth the people by the clouds and giveth meat in abundance.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the abundance here is the point: the God who judges by the storm is the same God who feeds by the rain.
